entry.summary: Visa-free for business visits up to 90 days.
entry.note: First-pass triage carried from Australian World Travel; recheck against the official source.

consular.notes: Australia doesn’t have an Embassy in Nicaragua. The Office of the Embassy of Canada to Nicaragua provides consular assistance for Australians in Nicaragua. Australian provisional travel documents can be issued at this office. - Special travel documents (Australian Passport Office) You can also get consular assistance from the Australian Embassy in Mexico City.
